==========================================
Qt object macro in class body
==========================================

class Foo : public QObject
{
Q_OBJECT
public:
    void bar();
};

---

(translation_unit
  (class_specifier
    name: (type_identifier)
    (base_class_clause
      (access_specifier)
      (type_identifier))
    body: (field_declaration_list
      (macro_declaration)
      (access_specifier)
      (field_declaration
        type: (primitive_type)
        declarator: (function_declarator
          declarator: (field_identifier)
          parameters: (parameter_list))))))

==========================================
Qt signals and slots section labels
==========================================

class Foo : public QObject
{
Q_OBJECT
signals:
    void ready();
public slots:
    void onReady();
private Q_SLOTS:
    void helper();
Q_SIGNALS:
    void done(int code);
};

{

};

==========================================
Qt emit statements in function body
==========================================

void Foo::run()
{
    emit ready();
    Q_EMIT done(42);
    emit model->changed(a, b);
}

---

(translation_unit
  (function_definition
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (qualified_identifier
        scope: (namespace_identifier)
        name: (identifier))
      parameters: (parameter_list))
    body: (compound_statement
      (emit_statement
        (expression_statement
          (call_expression
            function: (identifier)
            arguments: (argument_list))))
      (emit_statement
        (expression_statement
          (call_expression
            function: (identifier)
            arguments: (argument_list
              (number_literal)))))
      (emit_statement
        (expression_statement
          (call_expression
            function: (field_expression
              argument: (identifier)
              field: (field_identifier))
            arguments: (argument_list
              (identifier)
              (identifier))))))))

================================================================================
Qt function-like declaration macros
================================================================================

class Counter : public QObject {
  Q_OBJECT
  Q_PROPERTY(int value READ value WRITE setValue NOTIFY valueChanged)
  Q_ENUMS(Priority)
  Q_DECLARE_METATYPE(Counter)

public:
  int value() const;
  void setValue(int v);
};

Q_GLOBAL_STATIC(Counter, globalCounter)
Q_COREAPP_STARTUP_FUNC(initCounter)

---

      (field_declaration

================================================================================
Q_PLUGIN_METADATA and flag macros
================================================================================

class Plugin : public QObject {
  Q_OBJECT
  Q_PLUGIN_METADATA(IID "org.example.Plugin" FILE "plugin.json")
  Q_INTERFACES(PluginInterface)
  Q_DISABLE_COPY_MOVE(Plugin)
};

==========
Qt declaration macro inside preproc guard
==========

#ifndef GUARD_H
#define GUARD_H

class C {};

Q_DECLARE_METATYPE(const C*)

#endif

---

(translation_unit
  (preproc_ifdef
    name: (identifier)
    (preproc_def
      name: (identifier))
    (class_specifier
      name: (type_identifier)
      body: (field_declaration_list))
    (macro_declaration
      (macro_argument_list
        (identifier)))))

==========
Qt statement macro without semicolon
==========

void f() {
    Q_UNUSED(parent)
    Q_ASSERT(p);
    Q_FOREACH(QString s, list)
    if (a) return;
}

---

(translation_unit
  (function_definition
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list))
    body: (compound_statement
      (qt_statement_macro
        (macro_argument_list
          (identifier)))
      (qt_statement_macro
        (macro_argument_list
          (identifier)))
      (qt_foreach_statement
        type: (type_identifier)
        declarator: (identifier)
        right: (identifier)
        body: (qt_foreach_body
          (if_statement
            condition: (condition_clause
              value: (identifier))
            consequence: (return_statement)))))))
